title: Nvidia Soars as Huang Returns, Lifting Stocks and Crypto Shares
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Nvidia Soars as Huang Returns, Lifting Stocks and Crypto Shares Nvidia shares jumped about 35% on Monday after the board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, lifting the Nasdaq, chip stocks, bitcoin, Coinbase, Strategy and miners. This post Nvidia Soars as Huang Returns, Lifting Stocks and Crypto Shares first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
